'''The Indian Card Clothing Company''' Ltd. (abbreviated as ICC) is a [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] listed company headquartered in [[Pune]], [[India]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sify.com/finance/stockpricequote/Indian_Card_Clothing_Company_LtdFully_paid_Eq_Sh-ICD/location.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110204231807/http://www.sify.com/finance/stockpricequote/Indian_Card_Clothing_Company_LtdFully_paid_Eq_Sh-ICD/location.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=2011-02-04|title=Indian Business News {{!}} Sensex, Nifty {{!}} Indian Stock Market {{!}} BSE, NSE India {{!}} Stock Tips & Quotes, IPO|website=[[Sify]]|access-date=2017-10-24}}</ref> Founded in 1955,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://profit.ndtv.com/stock/indian-card-clothing-company-ltd_indiancard/reports|title=Indian Card Clothing: Reports, Company History, Directors Report, Chairman's Speech, Auditors Report of Indian Card Clothing - NDTVProfit.com|website=profit.ndtv.com|language=en|access-date=2017-10-24}}</ref> ICC is a [[precision engineering]] company that manufactures and supplies card clothing<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.indiamart.com/indian-card-clothing/|title=Indian Card Clothing Corporated Limited, Pune - Manufacturer of Accura Back Zone Carding Machine|website=IndiaMART.com|language=en|access-date=2017-10-24}}</ref> products and [[carding]] solutions for the [[textile]] [[Industry (economics)|industry]].

== History ==
It was incorporated on 24 June 1955 as a private company and in 1975 was converted to a public listed company jointly promoted by Carclo Engineering and English Card Clothing.<ref name=":0" /> In 1985, English Card Clothing (100% subsidiary of Carclo Engineering) sold its 57% stake in ICC to the new management.

Currently, Mauritius based Multi-Act Industrial Enterprises Limited is the holding company with 57.35% equity in the organization.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.valueresearchonline.com/stocks/shareholding_pattern.asp?code=1689|title=Indian Card Clothing Co. Ltd. - Stock Shareholding Pattern - Value Research Online|website=www.valueresearchonline.com|language=en|access-date=2017-10-25}}</ref>

ICC also holds a 100% equity in UK-based Garnett Wires that manufactures card clothing for the non-woven segment.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-sector-others/mr-m-k-trivedi-managing-director-indian-card-clothing-company-ltd-113111400259_1.html|title=Mr. M.K.Trivedi, Managing Director, Indian Card Clothing Company Ltd|last=indiainfoline.com|access-date=2017-10-24}}</ref>

== Products ==
ICC manufactures and supplies carding solutions for the textile industry.<ref name=":0"/>

== Facilities ==
The Indian Card Clothing manufacturing facilities are in Pune, Maharashtra and Nalagarh, Himachal Pradesh.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nseindia.com/content/corporate/eq_INDIANCARD_base.pdf|title=Preview|website=www.nseindia.com|access-date=2017-10-24}}</ref>

== Locations ==
The company has offices in India and overseas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dynamiclevels.com/en/indian-card-clothing-company-location|title=INDIAN CARD CLOTHING Company Location|website=Dynamic Levels|language=en-US|access-date=2017-10-25}}</ref>

extract: The Indian Card Clothing Company Ltd. (abbreviated as ICC) is a Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange listed company headquartered in Pune, India. Founded in 1955, ICC is a precision engineering company that manufactures and supplies card clothing products and carding solutions for the textile industry.
